summary: Mutilate with Murder 2/2, for a Humanoid or Giant boss.
advantage: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants. It does nothing against other bosses.
advantageShort: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh when about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6s left); spend leftover points in the last 3s
Vanish into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer (Shadowmeld into Ambush for a Night Elf)
Mutilate right after a main-hand swing (0.75s)
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Murder (+4% damage) only works against Humanoids and Giants.
Backstab with the same talents is the Seal Fate Daggers build, 13 DPS ahead.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Natural flasks on (standards 11: Hyjal Summit or the Barrow Deeps).
Hit held at the 8% yellow cap (standards 4); the old 9% sets did 0.4 to 2.8 more through the white hits.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as rogue__mutilate except talents, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeHumanoid, as the class preset's encounter does.
